title: Concept: Template element containing an executable script
description: A template element whose content includes a script in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The template stays inert until a script clones its content, and cloning inserts the nested script into the live document, so a sanitiser that ignores template contents leaves a stored payload.
applicability: Deployments that render a template element whose content includes a script into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The template stays inert until a script clones its content, and cloning inserts the nested script into the live document, so a sanitiser that ignores template contents leaves a stored payload.
